cc:Work.dc:description: Illustrative ideal bandwidth ceilings: 273 GB/s divided by 35 GB/token = 7.8 token/s; 1200 GB/s divided by 35 GB/token = 34.2857 token/s. One-stream dense decoding, all raw weights streamed each token. Not a benchmark or expected speed. Ignores all other work and traffic; not applicable to MoE, batching or speculative decoding.
